title: Google Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is now available on Unity Gateway
body: Google [Gemini Nano Banana 2.1](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#gemini-nano-banana-2-1) is available on Unity Gateway. Use [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis) to generate images from text and image inputs.
